title: Trends in International Arms Transfers, 2023–2024
publisher_or_archive: SIPRI Policy Briefs / Arms Transfers Database, Stockholm
summary: Authoritative global arms trade audit documenting that the United States increased its dominance to account for 42–43% of total global major arms exports, delivering major weaponry to over 100 sovereign states worldwide—surpassing the combined arms deliveries of the next three largest exporters (France, Russia, and China).
